meta.name: learn
meta.description: Distill a reusable skill from anything — a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or what you just did together — or refine an existing skill with new learnings. Use when the user says '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', 'capture this workflow', 'make a skill from <source>', or 'improve/update the <name> skill'. Produces or updates a .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md authored to NanoClaw's skill guidelines. (This CREATES or REFINES a skill from a source; it does not install existing skills from a registry.)

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从任何来源提炼或改进可复用的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把操作流程固化为可复用的技能
copy.tagline_en: Distill or refine a reusable skill from any source
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to turn workflows into reusable skills

howto.what: 把目录、URL、粘贴的笔记或刚才一起做过的流程,整理成一个可复用的技能文件(.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md),也能在已有技能里补充新经验。
howto.when: 当你说「/learn」「learn this」「把这段流程做成技能」等,或指定要改进某个已有技能时触发。

say.text: /learn 这个目录,帮我做成一个技能
say.note: 读取目录内容后生成 SKILL.md
把当前对话的工作流整理成技能

say.text: 更新 wow-on-steam-deck 这个技能
say.note: 在原有技能上原位补入新经验

howto.what_en: Turns a directory, a URL, pasted notes, or the work just done in this conversation into a reusable skill file (.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md); it can also refine an existing skill with new learnings.
howto.when_en: Use when you say '/learn', 'learn this', 'turn this into a skill', or ask to update an existing skill. It creates or refines skills; it does not install them from a registry.

say_en.text: /learn this directory and make it a skill
say_en.note: Reads the files and writes a SKILL.md
Distills the current workflow into a skill
Updates that skill in place with new learnings
